title: His lights
html_source:
Used here literally to mean “lungs” as a culinary term. Sometimes cooked together with liver in a stew, for an alliterative “liver and lights”
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lights_(offal)

I can see a hint at other meanings for word in the context of Bloom’s vision of the dead “mousing around” for all their necessary parts at the resurrection.

anchor.prefix: ea. Knocking them all up out of their graves. Come forth, Lazarus! And he came fifth and lost the job. Get1961#105 up! Last day! Then every fellow mousing around for his liver and
